questions.text: Solve 3x + 7 = 32 − 2x. What is x?
questions.textZh: 解方程 3x + 7 = 32 − 2x，x 等于多少？

questions.text: 22 workers each make 1200 bolts or 2000 nuts a day; each bolt needs 2 nuts. How many workers should make bolts?
questions.textZh: 车间 22 名工人，每人每天生产螺钉 1200 个或螺母 2000 个，1 个螺钉配 2 个螺母。应安排多少名工人生产螺钉？

questions.text: 1 m³ of wood makes 20 tabletops or 400 legs; a table is 1 top + 4 legs. With 12 m³, how many m³ go to tabletops?
questions.textZh: 1 m³ 木材可做 20 个桌面或 400 条桌腿，一张桌子 1 面配 4 腿。现有 12 m³ 木材，做桌面应用多少立方米？

questions.text: One person sorts the books in 40 h. Some start for 4 h, then 2 more join and all work 8 h to finish. How many started?
questions.textZh: 整理一批图书，一个人做要 40 h。先安排一部分人做 4 h，再增加 2 人一起做 8 h 完成。先安排了多少人？

questions.text: Two coats each sell for 60 yuan: one at 25% profit, one at 25% loss. How many yuan are lost in total?
questions.textZh: 两件衣服都卖 60 元，一件盈利 25%，另一件亏损 25%。总共亏了多少元？

questions.text: A jacket is marked up 50% over cost, then sold at 80% of the mark — still 28 yuan profit. What is its cost?
questions.textZh: 夹克按成本提高 50% 标价，再打八折出售，每件仍获利 28 元。成本是多少元？

questions.text: An item costs 60 yuan and sells at 25% profit. What is the selling price?
questions.textZh: 一件商品进价 60 元，盈利 25%，售价是多少元？

questions.text: A price drops 20%. By what percent must sales grow to keep the same revenue?
questions.textZh: 商品降价 20%，要使销售总金额不变，销量应增加百分之几？

questions.text: Group A: 4 people make 4 × quota + 20. Group B: 5 people make 6 × quota − 20. Per-person output is equal. What is the quota?
questions.textZh: 甲组 4 人共完成 4 × 定额 + 20 件，乙组 5 人共完成 6 × 定额 − 20 件，两组人均相等。定额是多少件？

questions.text: Deal 1: 50 off every 100+ order. Deal 2: 40% off. At what list price (≥ 100) do both cost the same?
questions.textZh: 满 100 减 50 和打六折，原价（不少于 100 元）是多少元时两种实付相等？

questions.text: Diophantus' tomb: 1/6 childhood, 1/12 youth, 1/7 more till married, 5 years to a son, son lived 1/2 his age, 4 more years. His age?
questions.textZh: 丢番图墓碑：一生的 1/6 是童年，1/12 是少年，再过 1/7 结婚，5 年后生子，儿子只活了他一半的岁数，又过 4 年他去世。他活了多少岁？

questions.text: Win 3, draw 1, loss 0. An unbeaten team played 14 games for 28 points. How many wins?
questions.textZh: 足球胜一场 3 分、平一场 1 分、负 0 分。一支球队 14 场保持不败，积 28 分。胜了几场？

questions.text: How many edges does a cube have?
questions.textZh: 正方体有多少条棱？

questions.text: How many faces does a hexagonal prism have?
questions.textZh: 六棱柱有几个面？

questions.text: A segment has 5 points on it (ends included). How many segments are in the picture?
questions.textZh: 一条线段上共有 5 个点（含两个端点），图中一共有多少条线段？

questions.text: Four lines cross each other. At most how many crossing points are there?
questions.textZh: 四条直线两两相交，最多有多少个交点？

questions.text: Extend AB to C so BC = AB/3. D is the midpoint of AC and DC = 2. How long is AB?
questions.textZh: 延长线段 AB 到 C，使 BC 等于 AB 的三分之一，D 是 AC 的中点。若 DC = 2，AB 是多少？

questions.text: How many minutes (′) is 0.4°?
How many seconds (″) are in 1°?
questions.textZh: 1° 等于多少秒（″）？

questions.text: An angle’s supplement is 150°. What is its complement, in degrees?
questions.textZh: 一个角的补角是 150°，这个角的余角是多少度？

questions.text: An angle's supplement is 3 times its complement. How many degrees is the angle?
questions.textZh: 一个角的补角是它余角的 3 倍，这个角是多少度？

questions.text: How many degrees does a clock’s minute hand turn in 1 minute?
questions.textZh: 时钟的分针 1 分钟转过多少度？

questions.text: At 3:25, what angle do the hour and minute hands make, in degrees?
questions.textZh: 3 时 25 分，时针与分针所成的角是多少度？

questions.text: ∠COD = 35°, OC bisects ∠AOB and OD bisects ∠AOC. How many degrees is ∠AOB?
questions.textZh: ∠COD = 35°，OC 平分 ∠AOB，OD 平分 ∠AOC。∠AOB 是多少度？
